```{r}
#| label: r-config
#| include: false
library(ggplot2) # graphics
library(dplyr) # data manipulation

ggplot2::theme_set(
  ggplot2::theme_bw() +
    ggplot2::theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      text = ggplot2::element_text(size = 12, family = "serif")
    )
)

options(digits = 6)
```
